Мой коллега мне объяснил почему:
Когда код превращает видео и аудио в байты, то у аудио байтов больше чем у видео, и код не знает куда их девать. 
Я не проверял на более больших видео. Может быть придется добавить больше секунд.
\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\
My colleague explained to me why:
When the code turns video and audio into bytes, the audio bytes have more than the video, and the code doesn't know where to put them. 
I haven't checked on the bigger videos. You may need to add more seconds.

title: Add Support for Static Image Input with Full Audio Duration
body:
when I try to use a static image (e.g., demo_image.jpg) as the input along with an audio file (e.g., demo1_audio.wav), the output video ends up being too short—it matches the duration of the image-derived video (like 2 seconds) instead of the full audio length.

What I want to achieve is simple: use one single image as the video and have the output video last for the entire duration of the audio file. So if my audio is 9 seconds long, the output video would show that one image for the full 9 seconds.
author: moustafa126

comments.body:
Method 1: repreat your static image to 9 seconds video
Method 2: Use other audio-driven portrait animation method, such as Hallo2 or EchoMimic.

Actually, I would recommend the second method more, because lipsync is more suitable for video input and not as well-suited for static image input.
